meta.name: KERDOS restaurant industry vocabulary
meta.source: General foodservice language written by Claude (Aristotle): restaurant and hospitality terms plus butcher, seafood, produce, canned goods, cheese and dairy, world cuisine, baking and classic kitchen vocabulary. Not derived from any one vendor or client.
meta.status: Draft for Dino's review. Not loaded into the app.
rules: A cut or form makes a different product.
Canned, jarred and dried are different products from fresh.
A level, grade or size never makes a different product by default. A client may split it.
Boneless and skinless are information on the listing.
Brand and pack are information on the listing.
Shorthand with more than one meaning is resolved from the other words on the line, or sent to review. It is never guessed.
